tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i skong bshags dang gtor bsngo bcas nye bar bsdus pa dngos grub mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag bshags pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa bcas mdor bsdus te nyams su len par 'dod pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa bshams shing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag nyid dpal chen thugs las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ /'phros pas mchod rdzas nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med bdud rtsi'i sprin/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ngo bo 'od gsal chos sku'i ye shes las/ /rang bzhin ma 'gags shar ba'i rtsa gsum lha/ /thugs rje gang 'dul sprul sku'i rnam rol gyis/ /byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir skur bzhengs shig /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhi dbyings gdod nas rnam grol e ka dzaḥ gzhi snang ye shes snying po ma ning nag /zung 'jug dbyings rig dbyer med thig le rtsal/ /rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i rā hu la/ /tshogs brgyad rang grol dur khrod lha mo dang*/ /bde stong sgyu 'phrul tshe ring mched lnga sogs/ /ye shes las grub chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba dharma pā la badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ lhun grub dur khrod rol pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs dbyings su thim pa las/ /gang shar bde stong rol mor 'char ba'i dpyid/ /snod bcud rnam dag rdo rje'i grong khyer du/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas sprin ltar gtibs/ /sman rag phud kyi btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma ri ltar spungs/

/mthun rdzas spyan gzigs skar ltar bkra ba 'dis/ /rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sngags srung e ka dza ṭī'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /skyes mchog badz+ra sā' dhu'i thugs dam bskang*/ /drang srong khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nor skyong dur khrod bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dpal mgon bdun cu dregs pa sde brgyad sogs/ /rdo rje'i chos srung yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chag mthol bshags na/ /mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal nas kyang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa'i/ /mchog thun phrin las yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ka ḍā ki nī shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis rtsa gsum chos srung spyir 'bul/ spro na bye brag so sor/ ma ma traka rak+sha e ka tsa ṭī i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥkha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la shā sa na tri ling ging ka ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥkha raṃ khā hi/ tri badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥkha raṃ khā hi/ hrī shag ru rag raṃ nā ga tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha he yo ga sha la dzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥkha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐ ra li pra ma ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥkha raṃ khā hi/ bam̐ ha ri ni sa badz+ra pra mo ha tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hoḥkha raṃ khā hi/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na giṅka ra sa ma ya ba liṃ ta bhuñdza hoḥ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ hūm̐/ don dam spros bral ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /kun rdzob zhi chags khro bo'i rnam rol can/ /rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/

/lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /gnas skabs nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang bcu'i ye shes spor/ /khams gsum rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus/ /gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs dbu ma'i klong du sgrol/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bshad sgrub dang*/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad phrin spel/ /'gro kun phan dang bde ba'i dpal la sbyor/ /mthar thug ka dag rig stong rjen pa'i gshis/ /lhun grub snang bzhi'i ye shes la sbyor bas/ /zung 'jug 'ja' lus rdo rje'i grong khyer du/ /khams gsum 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces bstod cing phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na badz+ra muḥs gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ shis pa brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang shākya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal gyis sbyar ba sarba dā maṅga laṃ// //
